summary: AEON Biopharma filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing receipt of official FDA minutes from its Biosimilar Biological Product Development Type 2b meeting concerning ABP-450, a proposed biosimilar to BOTOX (onabotulinumtoxinA). The FDA agreed in principle with a two-stage comparative pharmacodynamic study design using CMAP measurement in the extensor digitorum brevis, offering sensitivity-strengthening recommendations. AEON plans to submit an IND in Q4 2026 and start the study in Q1 2027, and may use Daewoong's prior comparative clinical studies as supportive evidence subject to scientific bridging. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; this is a routine regulatory pipeline update, not a special situation.
